items.title: Evan Christopher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 1, 2009
items.q: And another good friend, Ahmet Ertegun

ctx.x: At the same time, when he died and also when Tony Scott died, it was shortly in that same period. And another good friend, Ahmet Ertegun when those guys passed away I did go through a period where I was feeling pretty sorry for myself and I had a friend remind me, how old are you? Meaning, really? That’s what happens, this is what happens. Now Kenny was too young, but at the same time it’s like okay, now you are no longer the student, you’re no longer the kid, you’re no longer the — circle of life, Simba. And…
He kind of went out at the top of his game.
